definition: Banks, established institutions and any profile with a pre-2011 start require evidence of first tokenization/RWA activity. Corporate incorporation, card credential tokenization and generic crypto trading do not qualify. Dates represent the earliest activity corroborated in the reviewed sources, not proof that no earlier private pilot existed. Preserve source precision; never infer an exact day.
